owner_request: After the Part 1 top-up, repair the wording of the new Part 1 items so that absolute-qualifier tells do not mark false statements, without changing truth values, IDs or legal defects, so the bank meets the TestNoAbsoluteTell statistical floors.
method_summary: Six already-live Part 1 items were revised (m1-229, m1-230, m1-231, m1-233, m1-234 and m1-235). No questions were added or retired. The legal defects, truth values, traps, stems, option sets, notes, quotes and other statements are unchanged, except for the language-alignment edits recorded below. The first pass removed absolute-qualifier tells from seven false English statements, and from the matching Traditional Chinese where that text also used a word in the Chinese absolute regex. After an independent review of that text, two language-alignment issues were fixed rather than left with unresolved doubts or language mismatches: the parenthetical 「（只備有英文版）」 was removed from the Chinese of true statement m1-235-1 so both languages state the same supported fact, and the English of false statement m1-234-3 was later rewritten so it states the same mandatory delay as the unchanged Chinese, still without TestNoAbsoluteTell tokens. Every revised item was answered blind, statement by statement in both languages, from the cited sources by executor subagents working in fresh contexts without keys, explanations or quotes; this is independent-context review, not a different-model panel. All 30 first-round verdicts on the six items matched the key. The final text of m1-229, m1-230, m1-231 and m1-233 is bound to that first-round review. m1-234 and m1-235 were reviewed again after the first alignment; all 9 second-round verdicts matched the key, and m1-235 is bound only to that second-round review. m1-234 was reviewed a third time after the further English alignment; all 5 third-round verdicts matched the key, with no remaining doubts or language mismatches, and it is bound only to that third-round review. Each recorded verdict is bound to the final stem, statements and citation by a text hash. Truth values were unchanged, so existing option sets and answer indexes were retained.

revisions.reason: Wording-only repair of the absolute-qualifier tell on false statement 2. English dropped “only” before “to be terrorist property”; Chinese dropped 「只」 before 「屬第17(1)(b)條所述恐怖分子財產」. The defect is unchanged: section 18 continued detention is for CBNIs reasonably suspected to be crime proceeds under section 17(1)(a), not terrorist property under section 17(1)(b). Truth values, traps, option sets and the answer index were retained.

Wording-only repair of the absolute-qualifier tell on false statement 5. English dropped “only” before “the person from whom it was seized”; Chinese dropped 「只」 before 「指該物品是從其處檢取的人」. The defect is unchanged: section 18(7) defines an interested person more broadly than the person from whom the CBNI was seized. Truth values, traps, option sets and the answer index were retained.

Wording-only repair of the absolute-qualifier tell on false statement 5. English dropped the opening “Only”; Chinese dropped 「只有」. The defect is unchanged: section 19 covers proceedings instituted in Hong Kong or elsewhere. Truth values, traps, option sets and the answer index were retained.

Wording-only repair of the absolute-qualifier tell on false statement 6. English dropped “alone” after the investigation ground in section 18(2)(b)(i); Chinese changed 「單憑」 to 「憑」 and 「而無須信納」 to 「而不信納」. The defect is unchanged: the section 18(2) conditions are cumulative, and the investigation ground cannot replace the reasonable-grounds suspicion that the CBNIs represent such crime proceeds. Truth values, traps, option sets and the answer index were retained.

Wording-only repair of the absolute-qualifier tell on false statement 3, followed by language-alignment edits so English and Chinese state the same exclusive delay. The first pass removed “need only” / 「只須」. After review, English was aligned to the unchanged Chinese mandatory delay, without TestNoAbsoluteTell tokens: “MSOs must wait until the relevant sanctions have already been implemented through Hong Kong legislation before screening all new designations against their client lists.” Chinese remains: 「金錢服務經營者須在有關制裁已透過香港法例實施之後，才按所有新指定的名單篩查本身的客戶名單。」 The defect is unchanged: circular MSSB/SAN_01/2018 requires screening as soon as practicable whenever lists are updated, including during the gap before Hong Kong implementation. Truth values, traps, option sets and the answer index were retained.

Wording-only repair of the absolute-qualifier tells on false English statements 3 and 4 (“alone” and “only”), and of 「只限於」 on Chinese statement 4. After the first review, the official parenthetical 「（只備有英文版）」 was removed from true Chinese statement 1 so both languages state the same supported fact, that the updated increased-monitoring statement exists and can be found on the FATF website. The defects are unchanged: increased monitoring is not a FATF call for countermeasures, and Myanmar is on the Call for Action list, not the sole jurisdiction under increased monitoring. Truth values, traps, option sets and the answer index were retained.

blind_review.method: Keyless bilingual packets from bank/review_packet.py and bank/blind.py packet. Executor subagents in fresh contexts read only the packet, bank/FORMAT.md and docs/text, searching with bank/find.py. They did not open the patch, keys, notes, quotes or prior answers. No different-family panel is claimed.

rounds.note: All 30 round-1 verdicts matched the key as it stood at round 1. m1-234 statement 3 and m1-235 statement 1 were then aligned across languages, so their round-1 verdicts no longer bind the final text. The final text of m1-229, m1-230, m1-231 and m1-233 is bound to this round.

A new subagent in a fresh context reviewed the post-alignment text of m1-234 and m1-235 only. All 9 verdicts matched the key. m1-235 had no doubts or language mismatches and is bound to this round. m1-234 still had a language mismatch on statement 3 (English as a permission to defer; Chinese as a mandatory delay), so its English was rewritten again and this round does not bind the final m1-234 text.
A new subagent in a fresh context reviewed the final text of m1-234 only. All 5 verdicts matched the key. No doubts or language mismatches remained.

quotes: EN s.18(1), interrupted by a page break: “An authorized officer may, within the period mentioned in” / “section 17(2), apply to the Court for an order to authorize the continued detention of CBNIs the officer reasonably suspects to be property mentioned in section 17(1)(a).” TC s.18(1), also interrupted: “獲授權人員可在第17(2) 條所述的期間內，向法院申請命令，以授權將該人員合理地懷疑屬第17(1)(a) 條所述的財” / “產的現金類物品，繼續扣留。”

EN s.18(1) authorises continued detention only of CBNIs reasonably suspected to be “property mentioned in section 17(1)(a)”. EN s.17(1)(b) is a seizure ground for “terrorist property within the meaning of section 2(1) of the United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance (Cap. 575)”, not a s.18 continued-detention ground. The s.18(2)(a) condition is likewise only “property representing the proceeds of an indictable offence mentioned in section 25(1) of the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 455)”. TC: 第18(1)條僅及「第17(1)(a) 條所述的財 / 產的現金類物品」；第17(1)(b)條是檢取「《聯合國( 反恐怖主義措施) 條例》( 第575 章) 第2(1) 條所指的恐怖分子財產」的權力，並非第18條繼續扣留的對象。
EN s.18(7): “Court (法院) means the Court of First Instance or the District Court;” TC s.18(7): “法院 (Court) 指原訟法庭或區域法院；”

Same s.18(7) definition: Court is the Court of First Instance or the District Court / 「原訟法庭或區域法院」, not a magistrate or the Court of Appeal. EN: “Court (法院) means the Court of First Instance or the District Court;” TC: “法院 (Court) 指原訟法庭或區域法院；”

EN s.18(3): “An order made under subsection (2) may authorize the continued detention of the CBNIs for a period specified in the order. The period must not exceed 3 months beginning on the date of the order.” TC s.18(3): “根據第(2) 款作出的命令，可授權在該命令指明的期間內，繼續扣留有關現金類物品，而該期間不得超過自該命令的日期起計的3 個月。”

EN s.18(5): “A new order must not— (a) specify a period exceeding 3 months beginning on the date of the order;” The “new order” is the order made under s.18(4) “On an application made by an authorized officer”. TC s.18(5)(a): “新命令 —— (a) 指明的期間，不得超過自該命令的日期起計的3 個月；” 第18(4)條： “凡獲授權人員提出申請，法院如信納第(2) 款所述的情況繼續存在，則可應有關申請，藉命令( 新命令)”

EN s.18(5)(b): “A new order must not— … (b) result in the total period of the detention of the CBNIs exceeding 2 years beginning on the date of the order made under subsection (2).” TC s.18(5)(b): “不得致使有關現金類物品的總扣留期間，超過自根據第(2) 款作出的命令的日期起計的2 年。”

Same s.18(5)(b) cap is 2 years, not 5. EN: “must not— … (b) result in the total period of the detention of the CBNIs exceeding 2 years beginning on the date of the order made under subsection (2).” TC: “不得致使有關現金類物品的總扣留期間，超過自根據第(2) 款作出的命令的日期起計的2 年。”

EN s.18(6): “the Court may direct their return to an interested person in relation to the CBNIs or, if there is more than one such interested person, any one of them, if— (a) the Court is satisfied on an application made by an interested person in relation to the CBNIs that the conditions for their detention do not, or no longer, exist; or (b) the Court is satisfied on an application made by an authorized officer that their detention is no longer justified.” TC s.18(6): “法院可指示將該等物品，發還予該等物品的關係人或( 如有多於一名該等關係人) 其中任何一名關係人 —— (a) 法院應該等物品的關係人提出的申請而信納，扣留該等物品的情況不存在或不再存在；或 (b) 法院應獲授權人員提出的申請而信納，再無理據扣留該等物品。”

EN s.18(7): “interested person (關係人), in relation to any CBNI, means— (a) the person from whom it was seized; (b) a person by whom or on whose behalf it was imported or exported; or (c) a person who otherwise has an interest in it.” TC: “關係人 (interested person) 就現金類物品而言，指 —— (a) 如該物品是從某人處檢取的—— 該人； (b) 輸入或輸出該物品的人，或由他人代為輸入或輸出該物品的人；或 (c) 在其他方面對該物品有權益的人。” The statement includes (a) but wrongly excludes (b) and (c).

EN s.19, interrupted by a page break: “If, at any time while CBNIs are being detained under section 17(2) or an order made under section 18, any of the following” / “proceedings are instituted, the CBNIs may be detained until the proceedings have been concluded—” TC s.19, also interrupted: “如有現金類物品，根據第17(2) 條被扣留，或按根據第18 條作出的命令被扣留，而在扣留該等物品的任何時間，有以下” / “任何法律程序提起，則在該程序結束前，該等物品可予繼續扣留 ——”

EN s.19(a) (after the page break): “proceedings instituted (whether in Hong Kong or elsewhere) against a person for an offence with which the CBNIs are connected;” TC s.19(a): “就與該等物品相關的罪行，針對某人提起的法律程序( 不論該程序是在香港或其他地方提起)；”
EN s.19(b): “proceedings instituted (whether in Hong Kong or elsewhere) which may result in the forfeiture or confiscation of the CBNIs.” TC s.19(b): “可導致該等物品被沒收或充公的法律程序( 不論該程序是在香港或其他地方提起)。”

Further detention under s.19 is “until the proceedings have been concluded” / 「在該程序結束前，該等物品可予繼續扣留」, not a further 10 working days. The “not more than 10 working days after the day of seizure” limit is the initial detention in EN s.17(2): “Subject to sections 18 and 19, an authorized officer may detain the CBNIs for a period of not more than 10 working days after the day of seizure.” TC s.17(2): “除第18 及19 條另有規定外，獲授權人員可扣留有關現金類物品，惟扣留期間不得超過檢取日期後的10 個工作日。”
EN s.19(a) and (b) both include “whether in Hong Kong or elsewhere”. TC: “不論該程序是在香港或其他地方提起”. Proceedings instituted elsewhere do count.

EN s.18(2): “The Court may make the order if it is satisfied that— (a) there are reasonable grounds for suspecting that the CBNIs are property representing the proceeds of an indictable offence mentioned in section 25(1) of the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 455); and (b) …” The “(a)” limb is a necessary condition (“only if”). TC: “法院如信納有以下情況，則可作出有關命令 —— (a) 有合理理由懷疑，有關現金類物品屬《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》( 第455 章) 第25(1) 條所述的、代表從可公訴罪行的得益的財產；及 (b) …”

EN s.18(2) joins (a) and (b) with “and”: the Court must also be satisfied that “the detention of the CBNIs is justified while—” one of (i), (ii) or (iii). TC: “(a) …；及 (b) 在以下行動進行期間，扣留該等物品是有理可據的 ——” 其下分(i)(ii)(iii)，兩項條件累積適用。
EN s.18(2)(b)(i): “the detention of the CBNIs is justified while— (i) their origin or derivation is further investigated;” TC: “在以下行動進行期間，扣留該等物品是有理可據的 —— (i) 對該等物品的來源或如何獲得該等物品，作進一步調查；”

EN s.18(2)(b)(ii): “consideration is given to the institution (whether in Hong Kong or elsewhere) of proceedings against a person for an offence with which the CBNIs are connected;” TC: “考慮就與該等物品相關的罪行，針對某人提起法律程序( 不論該程序是在香港或其他地方提起)；”

EN s.18(2)(b)(iii): “consideration is given to the institution (whether in Hong Kong or elsewhere) of proceedings which may result in the forfeiture or confiscation of the CBNIs.” TC: “考慮提起可導致該等物品被沒收或充公的法律程序( 不論該程序是在香港或其他地方提起)。”

s.18(2)(a) and (b) are cumulative (“and” / 「及」). The Court cannot make the order on (b)(i) alone “without being satisfied” of the s.18(2)(a) suspicion of crime proceeds. EN: “if it is satisfied that— (a) there are reasonable grounds for suspecting that the CBNIs are property representing the proceeds of an indictable offence mentioned in section 25(1) of the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 455); and (b) the detention of the CBNIs is justified while— (i) their origin or derivation is further investigated;” TC: “法院如信納有以下情況，則可作出有關命令 —— (a) 有合理理由懷疑，有關現金類物品屬…代表從可公訴罪行的得益的財產；及 (b) …”

EN opening: "the Customs and Excise Department (“C&ED”) would like to further elaborate the expectations on actions that should be taken by Money Service Operators (“MSOs”) regarding sanctions imposed by the United Nations Security Council (“UNSC”) and the early alert circulars which will be issued by the C&ED on this subject from time to time." TC 開首: 「現擬進一步闡述海關預期金錢服務經營者如何因應聯合國安全理事會（聯合國安理會）所施加的制裁採取行動，並述明海關會不時就此事及早發出警示通函。」

EN s.1 p.1: "Sanctions lists are published and updated via notices in the Government Gazette pursuant to the relevant legislation.  The C&ED provides links to these notices in its circulars issued to MSOs and requires them to screen all new designations against their client lists as soon as practicable whenever there are such updates." TC 第1條第1頁: 「政府憲報會依據相關法例刊登公告，以公布並更新制裁名單。海關會將這類公告的超連結載於發給金錢服務經營者的通函，並規定但凡名單更新後，金錢服務經營者須在實際可行情況下，盡快按所有新指定的名單篩查本身的客戶名單。」

EN s.1 p.1: "In practice, there is likely to be a time gap between issuance of new or revised sanctions resolutions and/or sanctions lists, and their implementation in Hong Kong.  The C&ED would remind MSOs that whether or not UNSC sanctions resolutions or sanctions lists have been implemented through Hong Kong legislation, there are offences under existing anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing laws that are relevant." TC 第1條第1頁: 「在實際運作上，新的制裁決議及／或制裁名單或其修訂版發出後，直至在香港實施兩者，時間上難免有落差。現提醒金錢服務經營者，不論聯合國安理會的制裁決議或制裁名單有否透過在香港立法實施，現行針對洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的法例已有相關適用的罪行」 EN s.1 after the p.1 break (no corresponding official TC in the truncated extract): "MSOs should therefore ensure that in their sanctions screening of customers and payments, they pay regard to countries, individuals, entities and activities included in UNSC sanctions resolutions and sanctions lists as soon as practicable after they are promulgated by the UNSC and regardless of whether the relevant sanctions have been implemented in Hong Kong via UNSO or otherwise."

EN s.1 p.1: "In practice, there is likely to be a time gap between issuance of new or revised sanctions resolutions and/or sanctions lists, and their implementation in Hong Kong." TC 第1條第1頁: 「在實際運作上，新的制裁決議及／或制裁名單或其修訂版發出後，直至在香港實施兩者，時間上難免有落差。」

EN s.1 p.1: "The C&ED would remind MSOs that whether or not UNSC sanctions resolutions or sanctions lists have been implemented through Hong Kong legislation, there are offences under existing anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing laws that are relevant." TC 第1條第1頁: 「現提醒金錢服務經營者，不論聯合國安理會的制裁決議或制裁名單有否透過在香港立法實施，現行針對洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的法例已有相關適用的罪行」

EN item (2): In addition, the FATF has issued an updated statement on Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring Note 6 which can be found at: https://www.fatf-gafi.org/content/fatf-gafi/en/publications/High-risk-and-other-monitored-jurisdictions/increased-monitoring-june-2026.html EN item (1) heading, the referent of that “In addition”: (1) FATF Statement on High-Risk Jurisdictions subject to a Call for Action. TC 第(2)項: 此外，特別組織發布了一份有關被加強監察的司法管轄區的最新聲明，該聲明可於其網站（只備有英文版）取覽. TC 第(1)項標題: (1) 財務行動特別組織有關呼籲各方對高風險司法管轄區採取行動的聲明.

EN item (2): The statement sets out the list of jurisdictions that have committed to resolve swiftly strategic deficiencies in their regime to counter money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing within agreed timeframes and are subject to increased monitoring. The FATF will closely monitor the progress made by these jurisdictions in addressing the identified strategic deficiencies. TC 第(2)項: 該聲明載有承諾於協定時間內迅速解決其在打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及大規模毀滅武器擴散資金籌集制度方面的策略性缺失，且受加強監察的司法管轄區的名單。特別組織將會密切監察這些司法管轄區在處理已識別的策略性缺失方面的進展。

EN item (2) does not call for countermeasures: The FATF will closely monitor the progress made by these jurisdictions in addressing the identified strategic deficiencies and encourages its members to take into account the information presented in the statement in their risk analysis. EN item (1), a separate category: (i) Jurisdictions subject to a FATF call for applying countermeasures; and For all countries identified as high-risk, the FATF calls on all members and urges all jurisdictions to apply enhanced due diligence, and, in the most serious cases, apply countermeasures to protect the international financial system from the money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing risks emanating from those countries. TC 第(2)項: 特別組織將會密切監察這些司法管轄區在處理已識別的策略性缺失方面的進展，並鼓勵其成員在進行風險分析時參考該聲明所載述的資料。 TC 第(1)項(i): (i) 需遵從特別組織要求而採取針對措施的司法管轄區。

EN item (2): Money service operators (“MSOs”) are reminded that two new jurisdictions were added into the list, namely Bosnia and Herzegovina and Iraq. TC 第(2)項: 金錢服務經營者應留意，最新名單加入了兩個司法管轄區，即波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那及伊拉克。
